read.thesis: Tesla's Q2 2026 call shows auto margin down to 16.3% ex-credits and FCF negative $1.1B as capex more than doubled, with management guiding capex above $25B and debt capacity up to $30B.

capex.peers_comment: Samsung and TSMC are building fabs and Panasonic has invested many billions in battery cell production, per management.
capex.quote: We continue to expect that CapEx for this year will be more than $25 billion.

triggers.label: Capex >$25B, rising 2-3 years
triggers.quote: CapEx will grow for the next two to three years as we expand our robotaxi fleet
triggers.highlight: CapEx will grow for the next two to three years

triggers.label: Free cash flow -$1.1B in Q2
triggers.quote: Most of the reason for the -- it going negative is because CapEx more than doubled sequentially

triggers.label: Auto GM ex-credits 19.2% → 16.3%
triggers.quote: Automotive margins, excluding regulatory credits, declined sequentially from 19.2% to 16.3%.

triggers.label: Energy GM 39.5% → 20.4%
triggers.quote: Despite this growth, energy gross margins declined from 39.5% to 20.4%.
triggers.highlight: energy gross margins declined from 39.5% to 20.4%

triggers.label: Storage ASPs falling on competition
triggers.quote: we had previously guided that ASPs for industrial storage is coming down amidst growing competition
triggers.highlight: ASPs for industrial storage is coming down amidst growing competition

triggers.label: Order backlog largest since 2023
triggers.quote: We exited Q2 with our largest order backlog since 2023.

guidance.quote: We continue to expect that CapEx for this year will be more than $25 billion.
Long term, we believe the energy business should normalize at a gross margin rate in the mid- to low 20% range.

guidance.value: accelerate through the year, new US markets
guidance.quote: We expect the ramp of the fleet to accelerate throughout the year, along with the expansion into new U.S. markets.
